note: Measured against the published v9 gameplay export pack (/mnt/archive/datasets/melee/skirmish-gameplay/v9-snapshot-20260912/fox-fd/match-data.json; identical to v8 for this recording's own checked range). Previous baseline (93 frames, first divergence -30, P4's action_state expected 0x0028/Guard actual 0x0027/GuardOn) was misdiagnosed at capture time as a shield-family bug; re-diagnosed this batch as Squat/SquatWait (states 39/40), unrelated to the GuardOn/Guard/GuardReflect state_age fix a concurrent batch owns. Root cause: game::locomotion::update_actions routed Landing's own interruptible down-stick entry through the ordinary Squat crouch-down animation (start_squat/Action::Squat), but ftCo_Landing_IASA (ftCo_Landing.c:146-147) calls ftCo_SquatWait_CheckInput directly, skipping Squat's animation entirely (fn_800D62C4, no ftAnim_8006EBA4 advance) -- confirmed against this recording's own P4 sequence (Landing ages 0..3 at frames -34..-31, then action_state 40/SquatWait directly at -30 with no intervening 39/Squat frame). Fixed by branching that entry on f.action == Action::Landing (docs/validation.md's Landing-to-SquatWait routing fix). A sibling entry-advance bug in the ordinary (non-Landing) Squat path was fixed in the same batch (ftCo_Squat_Enter's own missing extra ftAnim_8006EBA4 advance, start_squat's action_frame = 1) but does not move this baseline on its own. Moved checked_frames from 93 to 103 (first_divergent_frame from -30 to -20). The new divergence at -20 is P4's action_age (expected 1.0, actual 0.0) on an EscapeAir entry frame (state 236, real ASID) -- ftCo_EscapeAir_Enter's own extra ftAnim_8006EBA4 advance (ftCo_EscapeAir.c:54-66), the same entry-advance shape, not yet fixed when this baseline was recorded.
